naming: Use sortable timestamps YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS and include tmux target identity when a pane is captured.

artifacts.proof: pane identities and active state at capture time only
bounded rendered pane history only; not command success by itself
selected pane, transport method, capture path and sensitivity decision
redacted GitHub CLI auth status only
human-readable state summary; no higher proof than cited evidence

capturePolicy.primary: Prefer exact tmux pane inventory plus bounded capture-pane over Android long-press selection or touch scrolling.
capturePolicy.sensitivePane: If the selected pane contains or may contain authentication secrets/device codes, do not persist it; switch to a non-sensitive pane or capture fresh sanitized output instead.

proofCeiling: Registry defines local evidence names and limits; artifact existence alone is never runtime success.
